source_notes.label: Study motivation, source-attributed
source_notes.summary: The authors frame magnetite as a high-Curie-temperature half-metallic ferrimagnet and study how nanocrystalline grain size relates to magnetization and magnetoresistance. This is the paper’s stated motivation.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, printed p. 8023, Introduction

source_notes.label: Authors’ interpretation of reduced magnetization
source_notes.summary: The authors discuss particle-size effects, surface spin disorder and possible antiphase boundaries as explanations for reduced, unsaturated magnetization. These are interpretations, not additional measured structure labels.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 3, printed p. 8024, magnetization discussion
